messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Elevated 5xx + 429 spike detected across gateway routes (us-west-1). Aggregated error rate 5xx=18% 429=12% over last 3m. Auto-pager fired. Pager: PD-48921
jamie_oncall: on it. grabbing context, pinging devon/sara.
devon: seeing huge backpressure on rl-service (rate-limiter). CPU spiking and lots of token-bucket drops. quick grep of logs shows config push ~3710001000 changed default_quota and scope.
sara_sre: can you paste the offending config?
devon: yep, suspect payload:
```request_limit: 100\nscope: global\ntenant_scoping: disabled\n```
this was meant to be per-tenant. looks like a deploy to rl-service-1 rolled to all pods.
jamie_oncall: that would cause global throttles -> 429s -> gateway retries -> 5xx. customer impact?
mike_support: Support seeing multiple customers reporting 502s and timeouts; first reports ~2.5m ago. I'm already triaging top-5 impacted tenants and escalating to their CSMs.
lucy_prodeng: wow. was that change in the rate-limiter rollout PR? who approved?
devon: PR 7823 merged ~3710000900, deploy started ~3710001000. it had a bad default. I can revert the config or pin a per-tenant override.
sara_sre: two parallel mitigations: 1) emergency revert of the config/feature flag, 2) enable fail-open routing fallback so gateway bypasses rl-service for a short window. which is faster?
jamie_oncall: do both in parallel. devon take revert, sara take gateway fallback. i'll coordinate comms and PD.
devon: rolling back RL config now — performing canary rollback to previous release on rl-service.* pods. command:
```kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/rl-service --to-revision=12```
watching pod restarts.
sara_sre: enabling gateway fail-open: flipping ff "rl_bypass_on_emergency" to true for us-west route. api call: POST https://ff-toggle.internal/flags/rl_bypass_on_emergency { "env": "prod", "region": "us-west-1", "value": true }
jamie_oncall: PD update: PD-48921 annotated: root cause suspected mis-scoped quota in rl-service deploy; mitigation=rollback + gateway bypass; impact=intermittent 5xx/429 for many tenants; ETA to restore baseline ~10-15m.
mike_support: pushing message templates to CSMs and posting status page note draft: "We are investigating increased errors for API requests in US-West; mitigation in progress."
devon: rollback finished on 3 of 5 nodes, CPU back down on those. still seeing 429 bursts from one AZ (us-west-1b). digging.
sara_sre: gateway logs show retries piling up from ingress-proxy to api-proxy causing connection pool exhaustion -> 502. I'm scaling api-proxy pool in us-west-1b and removing unhealthy upstreams.
lucy_prodeng: any customer-visible data we can give execs? SLA risk?
jamie_oncall: impact limited to a subset of routes; ~20% of requests in the region degraded for ~12m so far. no billing anomalies yet. will surface a post-incident customer list after full RCA.
devon: found the last pod in us-west-1b still running new config due to a stuck init job. manually restarted it.
sara_sre: api-proxy pools scaled, gateway bypass in place, rl-service rolled back everywhere — error rate trending down to 2.1% 5xx and 1.5% 429 now.
mike_support: support finished initial outreach to top 8 affected tenants; three reported degraded latency but no data loss.
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff note: jamie currently on-call owner. escalate to oncall-manager if <50% restoration in 20m.
jamie_oncall: will run post-restore checks and keep a 1:1 w/eng-sre. Sara/devon please collect logs for RCA: rate-limiter config history, rollout timeline, flag toggles, pod restart events.
devon: archiving config diffs + deploy timeline to /internal/incidents/3710001234/artifacts and saved rl-service logs: rl-service.stderr.
sara_sre: I've added traces showing increased retry loops at gateway for time window 3710000900-3710001900 and attached them to the incident.
jamie_oncall: status update for channel: "Mitigations applied (rollback + gateway bypass + scaling). Error rates back near baseline. Monitoring for residual errors. No data loss identified. Postmortem to follow; Pager duty ticket PD-48921 open." :thumbsup: 
lucy_prodeng: thanks — please include proposed deploy guardrails: require explicit tenant scope on quota PRs, add e2e that verifies per-tenant scoping, and an emergency flag kill-switch we can hit from console.
devon: agreed; i'll open follow-up PRs and include a canary condition that stops global-scoped quota from shipping.
sara_sre: next steps: RCA, timeline, customer impact list, and runbook updates (runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate_limit_cascade). planning incident review 48h.
mike_support: I will collect customer incident notes for comms team.
jamie_oncall: closing thread here once monitoring green for 30m. Thanks all for fast action.
